2.1.3.1-r2.burton_quote: The same Jupiter, and those bad angels are now worshipped, and adored by the name of St. Sebastian, Barbara, &c.

2.1.3.1-r3.burton_quote: And God often winks at these impostures, because they forsake his word, and betake themselves to the devil, as they do that seek after Holy water, crosses, &c.
